entities.summary: Corey Alexander Fuller is an American former professional football wide receiver. He is currently a college scout for the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Tech Hokies and was selected by the Detroit Lions in the sixth round of the 2013 NFL draft. He was also a member of the New Orleans Saints.
